summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all four paragraphs of the selected working Greek. Both preserve the dialogue, negations, Hermas’s sevenfold proposal, the shepherd’s response, and the stated hour/day/year comparisons without recalculation or doctrinal qualification. The simplified wording retains the source’s substantive claims and speaker distinctions. The notes accurately disclose the reported, edition-mediated Lavra selection and its older conjectural alternative, and distinguish the bracketed editorial supplement from preserved wording. The contextual rendering “Sir” is explicitly documented. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and honesty about the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation or publication readiness.
